login.title: Link Into The SSI

settings.title: Settings

privacy.title: Privacy & Data

consentPrompt.title: Set your preferences
consentPrompt.intro: Before you continue, choose how we may contact you. These are optional and off by default — you can change them anytime in Settings → Privacy & Data.
consentPrompt.note: Service, security, and legal processing happens regardless of these choices.

consent.title: Communication & analytics preferences
consent.note: These are optional and off by default. Change them anytime.
consent.marketing: Send me product news and tips by email

privacy.exportNote: Download a machine-readable copy of your account data. We'll prepare it and the download link will be available here (valid for 7 days).
privacy.exportExpired: Your previous export link has expired. Request a new one.
privacy.deleteNote: Permanently delete your account and personal data after a 30-day grace period. You can cancel within those 30 days by signing in again. Required billing records are kept in anonymized form as the law requires.
privacy.confirmBody: This schedules permanent deletion of your account in 30 days. Type DELETE to confirm.
privacy.deletionScheduledBody: Your account will be permanently deleted on {{date}}. You've been signed out. Sign in again before then to cancel. We've emailed you a confirmation.

policyUpdate.title: We've updated our Privacy Policy
policyUpdate.body: We've made changes to how we handle your data. Please review and acknowledge to continue.

bannedScreen.heading: Your account has been suspended
bannedScreen.body: An administrator has revoked your access to this app.

cancelDeletion.heading: Your account is scheduled for deletion
cancelDeletion.bodyWithDate: Your account and personal data will be permanently deleted on {{date}}. You can keep your account by cancelling the deletion.
cancelDeletion.bodyNoDate: Your account is pending deletion. You can keep it by cancelling the deletion.
